subject: general
question: Four words have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Mode, Mean, and Median are measures of** central tendency**, whereas **Range **measures the **dispersion of the data.**

 
• **Mode**: The value that appears most frequently in a data set.
 
• **Range**: The difference between the highest and lowest values in a data set.
 
• **Mean**: The average of all values in a data set.
 
• **Median**: The middle value when the data set is ordered.

Thus, the odd one is **Range**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"**Range**".**
